<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Gajjar Dev | Portfolio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#fff3f8;--surface:#ffffff;--ink:#3a1228;--muted:#8a5a74;--accent:#d81b73;--accent2:#ff9a3d;--accent3:#f26a1b;--soft:#ffe1ee;--line:#f8cfe1;--shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(216,27,115,.14);
box-sizing:border-box;}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#1c0b14;--surface:#2a1220;--ink:#fff0f6;--muted:#d9a9bf;--accent:#ff5c9d;--accent2:#ffa45c;--accent3:#ffa45c;--soft:#3d1a2d;--line:#55233c;--shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#1c0b14;--surface:#2a1220;--ink:#fff0f6;--muted:#d9a9bf;--accent:#ff5c9d;--accent2:#ffa45c;--accent3:#ffa45c;--soft:#3d1a2d;--line:#55233c;--shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:76px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1rem/1.7 Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.2}
a{color:var(--accent)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 85%,transparent);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:66px}
.logo{font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.logo b{color:var(--accent2)}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
nav a.l{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;transition:background .25s,color .25s}
nav a.l:hover,nav a.l.on{background:var(--soft);color:var(--accent)}
.ib{background:var(--soft);border:0;color:var(--ink);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px;transition:transform .3s}
.ib:hover{transform:rotate(20deg)}
#menu{display:none}
@media (max-width:760px){
#menu{display:inline-block}
nav .links{display:none;position:absolute;top:66px;left:0;right:0;flex-direction:column;background:var(--bg);padding:12px 22px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
nav .links.open{display:flex}
}
.links{display:flex;gap:6px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding:70px 0 60px}
@media (max-width:820px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:44px}}
.pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--soft);color:var(--accent);padding:6px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:18px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,6.4vw,2.8rem);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.grad{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent3));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.hero p{color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch;margin:18px 0 26px}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;margin:0 10px 10px 0;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.btn.main{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent3));color:#fff}
.btn.alt{border:2px solid var(--accent);color:var(--accent)}
.photo{justify-self:center;width:min(100%,360px)}
.cap{padding:26px 4px 4px;text-align:center}.cap b{display:block;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.3}.cap>span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;margin:6px 0 14px}.cap .tags{margin-top:0;justify-content:center}
.frame{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:36% 64% 55% 45%/50% 45% 55% 50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:5rem;font-weight:800;box-shadow:var(--shadow);animation:morph 9s ease-in-out infinite,float 5s ease-in-out infinite;overflow:hidden}
.frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
@keyframes morph{50%{border-radius:58% 42% 40% 60%/45% 58% 42% 55%}}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.badge{position:absolute;left:-10px;bottom:10px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:10px 16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-width:230px}
.badge b{display:block;font-size:.95rem}
.badge span{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}
.tag{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
section{padding:64px 0}
.eyebrow{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;font-size:.85rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em}
section h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,5vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700;margin:4px 0 8px}
.lead{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 30px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:var(--accent)}
.card h3{font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.card .where{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.ico{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr;gap:34px}
@media (max-width:820px){.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.about p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 14px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;align-content:start}
.stats .card{padding:16px 20px}
.stats b{display:block}
.stats span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.chip{background:var(--soft);color:var(--accent);padding:3px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:500}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.row .ico{margin:0}
.row b{display:block}
.row span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;word-break:break-word}
.big{padding:28px}.big h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.tl{grid-column:1/-1;padding:28px 28px 28px 46px}
.tl .it{position:relative;padding-bottom:22px}.tl .it:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl .it::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-24px;top:8px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}
.tl .it::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-19px;top:24px;bottom:-4px;width:2px;background:var(--line)}
.tl .it:last-child::after{display:none}
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:18px}
@media (max-width:760px){.cgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cgrid .big{grid-row:auto!important}}
footer{padding:28px 0 44px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;text-align:center}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.frame{animation:none}.rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}*{transition:none!important}}

/* ---- animations ---- */
.grad{background-size:200% auto;animation:shine 5s linear infinite}
@keyframes shine{to{background-position:200% center}}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.hero>div:first-child>*{animation:fadeUp .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
.hero>div:first-child>:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.1s}
.hero>div:first-child>:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.25s}
.hero>div:first-child>:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}
.hero>div:first-child>:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.55s}
.hero>div:first-child>:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.65s}
.logo b{display:inline-block;animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(1.5)}}
.blob{position:fixed;z-index:-1;width:46vmax;height:46vmax;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.22;pointer-events:none;animation:drift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.blob.a{background:var(--accent);top:-14vmax;left:-12vmax}
.blob.b{background:var(--accent2);bottom:-16vmax;right:-14vmax;animation-delay:-8s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate(8vmax,6vmax) scale(1.15)}}
#bar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;height:3px;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;z-index:30}
.card .ico{transition:transform .35s}
.card:hover .ico{animation:wiggle .6s ease}
@keyframes wiggle{25%{transform:rotate(-12deg) scale(1.15)}60%{transform:rotate(10deg) scale(1.15)}100%{transform:none}}
.btn.main{background-size:200% auto;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,background-position .5s}
.btn.main:hover{background-position:100% center}
.tag,.chip{transition:transform .25s,background .25s,color .25s}
.tag:hover,.chip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tl .it::before{animation:ring 2.4s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes ring{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 45%,transparent)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px transparent}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.grad,.logo b,.blob,.hero>div:first-child>*,.card:hover .ico,.tl .it::before{animation:none!important}#bar{display:none}}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]) .btn.main{color:#2a0d1c}}
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn.main{color:#2a0d1c}

/* ---- Mobile & Touch Enhancements ---- */
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-padding-top:calc(66px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px))}
header{padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
header .wrap{padding-left:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.wrap{padding-left:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.ib{min-width:44px;min-height:44px;width:44px;height:44px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.btn,nav a.l,.card.row{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
@media (hover:none){
  .card:hover,.btn:hover,.tag:hover,.chip:hover,.ib:hover{transform:none}
  .card:active{transform:scale(.99);border-color:var(--accent)}
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  nav .links{
    top:calc(66px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));
    background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 96%,transparent);
    backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    gap:4px;
  }
  nav a.l{padding:12px 16px;font-size:1rem;min-height:44px;display:flex;align-items:center}
  section{padding:48px 0}
  .lead{margin-bottom:22px;font-size:.95rem}
  .hero{padding:32px 0 42px;gap:28px;text-align:center}
  .hero p{margin:14px auto 22px;font-size:.96rem}
  .hero .btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;margin:0 0 12px 0;min-height:48px}
  .photo{width:min(100%,270px);margin-top:4px}
  .frame{font-size:3.8rem}
  .cap{padding-top:20px}
  .about{gap:20px}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
  .stats .card{padding:14px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}
  .card{padding:18px;border-radius:16px}
  .big{padding:20px}
  .tl{padding:22px 18px 22px 38px}
  .tl .it::before{left:-21px}
  .tl .it::after{left:-16px}
  .row{gap:12px;min-height:60px}
  footer{padding:24px 18px calc(32px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
}
@media (max-width:400px){
  .stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .logo{font-size:1.12rem}
  .hero h1{font-size:1.85rem}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="bar" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="blob a" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="blob b" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<header>
<div class="wrap">

<nav aria-label="Main">
<div class="links" id="links">

</div>

</nav>
</div>
</header>

<main>

<footer>© Gajjar Dev · Designed &amp; built with curiosity.</footer>

<script>
(function(){
var root=document.documentElement,tb=document.getElementById('theme');
function dark(){var t=root.getAttribute('data-theme');return t?t==='dark':matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches}
function sync(){tb.textContent=dark()?'☾':'☼'}
try{var s=localStorage.getItem('theme');if(s)root.setAttribute('data-theme',s)}catch(e){}
sync();
tb.addEventListener('click',function(){var n=dark()?'light':'dark';root.setAttribute('data-theme',n);try{localStorage.setItem('theme',n)}catch(e){}sync()});
var m=document.getElementById('menu'),l=document.getElementById('links');
function closeMenu(){l.classList.remove('open');m.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');m.textContent='☰'}
m.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.stopPropagation();var o=l.classList.toggle('open');m.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o);m.textContent=o?'✕':'☰'});
l.addEventListener('click',function(){closeMenu()});
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(l.classList.contains('open')&&!l.contains(e.target)&&e.target!==m)closeMenu()});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')closeMenu()});
var rv=document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);(function(t){setTimeout(function(){t.style.transitionDelay=''},1000)})(e.target)}})},{threshold:.12});
rv.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});
}else{rv.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')})}
var bar=document.getElementById('bar');
function prog(){var h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;bar.style.transform='scaleX('+(h>0?Math.min(scrollY/h,1):0)+')'}
window.addEventListener('scroll',prog,{passive:true});prog();
rv.forEach(function(el,i){el.style.transitionDelay=((i%3)*120)+'ms'});
var secs=document.querySelectorAll('main section, .hero'),links=document.querySelectorAll('.links a');
window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){var y=scrollY+120,cur='home';secs.forEach(function(s){if(s.offsetTop<=y)cur=s.id});links.forEach(function(a){a.classList.toggle('on',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+cur)})},{passive:true});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
